name: notched
what: A parametric two-lobed leaf with a central notch (a long-shoot-like leaf), to exercise the outline's notch and incisions and the veins' growth around them; its numbers are a typical leaf's, not one photographed leaf's.

radius_mm.source: blade length (base to the longest lobe's tip) 61.5-62.8 mm, Klimko 2015 Table 1 clone means [M], less the base cut and the distal shape's bulge [A]

half_angle_deg.source: a width of about 93 mm at this radius (Klimko 2015 Table 1, male clone 92.7 mm [M]) [D/A]

base_half_angle_deg.source: the blade's narrow wedge at the petiole [A, read off the photos by eye]

base_flare_mm.source: how far up the wedge opens to the fan [A, by eye]

distal_shape.source: a distal margin a little higher on the lobes than at the axis [A]

depth_mm.source: central notch depth 14.1 +- 10.7 mm, male clone, Klimko 2015 Table 1 [M]

wavelength_mm.source: [A, the photos' margin waves by eye]

count.source: secondary incisions [A]; Critchfield 1970: up to a third of the blade's length on late long-shoot leaves

flank_depth_mm.source: the margin deeper than this below the convex hull is a notch's or an incision's flank, which veins run along; shallower dips (the margin's waves, 1-3 mm) are ended on as on the rest of the distal margin [A]
